headline: Joy Audit, from entry to detail
overview: Log joy-inducing activities with category, frequency, and joy level to audit what brings genuine happiness into your life.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Joy Audit — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the joy activity logging form with category, frequency, and joy level inputs.
steps.screenshotAlt: Joy Audit landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Log activities that bring you joy with category tags
Rate the joy level each activity generates
Record how frequently you engage in each activity
Discover patterns and invest more in high-joy activities
tips: Include both big and small activities — joy often hides in everyday moments.
Review your audit monthly and deliberately schedule more of your highest-joy activities.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
